g.text: detect connection or run sequence gap
Chat delta is a standard event, not capability-gated.
Some chat deltas may be marked dropIfSlow.
A gap is observable because sequence numbers advance.
The wire format does not expose the fine-grained event.
There is no active-run snapshot protocol.
